== Biography ==
Allexander was born in 1637. He is the son of [[Glasgow-1148|Alexander Glasgow]] and [[Clerk-296|Jannet Clerk]]. 


Allexander Glasgow

Christening

3 Sep 1637

Inveresk and Musselburgh, Midlothian, Scotland

Father's Name:	

Allexander Glasgow

Mother's Name:	

Jannet Clerk

The parish index records Alexander Glasgow with Issobell Anderson at Edinburgh on 16 June 1665.<ref>Scotland’s People, Old Parish Registers, banns and marriages, OPR 685 / 1/440 / 78, 1665-06-16, Edinburgh; [https://www.scotlandspeople.gov.uk/ record].</ref> The index combines banns and marriage entries; the original register is required to establish the event type.

== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-1148]] is assessed at 99% (proved). The3 September 1637 Inveresk baptism explicitly names Allexander’s father Alexander Glasgow and mother Jannet Clerk. Alexander-1148 represents that exact Fisherrow/Musselburgh couple and the surrounding child sequence.

Recorded 1637 child and Clerk household; the older Alexander’s upstream James identity remains uncertain.

Next useful test: Retain this full-couple record anchor when comparing the sasines.
